title: Langley drones were targeting NASA and a specific base location
place_text: Langley Air Force Base / NASA Langley, Virginia

tellings.quote: those drones were really targeting primarily NASA and then a very specific location on Langley Air Force Base

plain: Around 2023, a swarm of drones over Langley in Virginia was mostly aiming at NASA, the US space agency, which has a research centre there, and at one very specific spot on Langley Air Force Base next door. That is what a guest named Dylan Borland tells Michels, speaking as someone who says he saw it or took part. If he is right, the flights were not random: someone was going after particular targets.
